name: Are there energy-efficient window options available?

mainEntity.name: Are there energy-efficient window options available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many energy-efficient window options are available to help reduce heating and cooling costs. These often include double or triple-pane glass with inert gas fills (like argon or krypton) between the panes, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and well-insulated frames. These features work together to minimize heat transfer, keeping your home more comfortable year-round.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, energy-efficient windows feature double/triple-pane glass, inert gas fills, Low-E coatings, and insulated frames to reduce heat transfer.
